summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around tariff-exemption and trade-compliance administration. The core chokepoint is not tariff exposure itself, but the paperwork, classification, customs brokerage, exemption filing, supply-chain visibility, and compliance workflow created by volatile tariff policy. The best underfollowed fit found in this pass is Radiant Logistics, a small-cap logistics platform with customs brokerage and a proprietary global trade management platform. Descartes is a stronger software/data pure-play but already mid-cap and better known. Expeditors and C.H. Robinson are larger reference/context names with customs brokerage and trade-policy services that can validate whether compliance workload is monetizing broadly.
